sql: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 END) AS single_bond_count FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id) AS t;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND a.element = 'f'
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM molecule m;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percentage FROM molecule m;
